codeReview.summary: The rerun correctly fixes three prior blocking findings (daemon tick cadence via interval, URL port parsing, and injective session-name encoding). However, the attached-registry concurrency finding is only partially addressed: unique temp paths prevent tmp-file clobber, but concurrent read-modify-write operations can still lose updates.

issues.description: register_attached/unregister_attached still do unlocked read-modify-write (`load_attached_registry` -> mutate -> `save_attached_registry`). The new unique tmp filename in save_attached_registry removes tmp-path collisions, but concurrent writers can still overwrite each other's logical updates (last-writer-wins), so the prior blocking race from fix-git-and-persistence-issues is not fully resolved.
test_registry_concurrent_access remains sequential and does not exercise real concurrent writers, so it cannot detect the remaining lost-update race.
